title: Ingress Tool Transfer (T1105)
text: Adversaries transfer tools or other files from an external system into a compromised environment. Files may be copied in over C2, or pulled down with native utilities (certutil, bitsadmin, curl, powershell Invoke-WebRequest) to live off the land. Evasion angle for detections: attackers switch between multiple download utilities, so a rule that names only one LOLBin (e.g. only certutil) is bypassed by using an alternate binary that produces the same ingress behavior.
